title: Quarantine cross-provider derivatives OI and ETF-flow aggregates until scope-normalized
decisions: Never average or pool aggregate open-interest totals from providers with different venue, instrument, settlement, quote-currency, contract-multiplier or timestamp coverage.
Store OI at the venue-contract-instrument level with source ID, raw observation time, retrieval time, contract type, quote asset, settlement asset, unit, multiplier and conversion methodology.
Compare providers only after a common venue/instrument intersection is constructed; preserve unmatched venues and instruments separately.
Treat liquidation heatmap clusters as provider-modelled estimates, not actual resting orders or guaranteed liquidation triggers.
Separate ETF spot holdings, index-fund holdings, shares outstanding, creations/redemptions, issuer-reported XRP units, AUM and estimated USD flow.
Do not treat BITW index rebalancing or holdings deltas as cash inflows without primary creation/redemption and cash-component evidence.
Do not admit these snapshots as model features until the source registry is verified and point-in-time raw inputs are retained.
